shortDescription: Create, Delete or Modify filesystems on Infinibox

options.name: fs_type
options.description: Specifies the file system type, regular or snapshot.

options.name: parent_fs_name
options.description: Specify a fs name. This is the fs parent for creating a snapshot. Required if fs_type is snapshot.

options.name: pool
options.description: Pool that will host file system.

options.name: restore_fs_from_snapshot
options.description: Specify true to restore a file system (parent_fs_name) from an existing snapshot specified by the name field. State must be set to present and fs_type must be 'snapshot'.

options.name: serial
options.description: Serial number matching an existing file system.

options.name: size
options.description: File system size in MB, GB or TB units. See examples.

options.name: snapshot_lock_expires_at
options.description: This will cause a snapshot to be locked at the specified date-time. Uses python's datetime format YYYY-mm-dd HH:MM:SS.ffffff, e.g. 2020-02-13 16:21:59.699700

options.name: snapshot_lock_only
options.description: This will lock an existing snapshot but will suppress refreshing the snapshot.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates/Modifies file system when present or removes when absent.

options.name: stay_logged_in
options.description: If True, persist API session to disk. Load the session on subsequent module calls. Persisted sessions are only usable for stay_logged_in_minutes.

options.name: stay_logged_in_minutes
options.description: Number of minutes for which a persisted session may be reused. After this time, the session data will be deleted. The time should be shorter than the IBOX session timeout time.

options.name: thin_provision
options.description: Whether the master file system should be thin or thick provisioned.

options.name: user
options.description: Infinibox User username with sufficient priveledges ( see notes ).

options.name: write_protected
options.description: Specifies if the file system should be write protected. Default will be True for snapshots, False for master file systems.
